# Filter rows where Position contains '1st' (exact match for 1st place)
first_place_years = df[df['Position'].str.contains('1st', na=False)]['Year'].unique()
# Get all years present in the dataframe
all_years = df['Year'].unique()
# Find years that are in all_years but not in first_place_years
years_without_first = [year for year in all_years if year not in first_place_years]
# Assign the first such year to answer (if any exist)
answer = years_without_first[0] if years_without_first else None
